items.title: Register Antigravity as a first-class host runtime
items.context: Current host runtime validation and probe code only accepts fake, claude-code, gemini, and codex. Add antigravity with command agy and keep any Gemini handling explicitly legacy/deprecated.

happy.desc: Antigravity is registered as a first-class dispatch runtime: host id antigravity is recognized, alias agy resolves to it, cliCommand is agy, invocation template uses agy with the prompt file, and runtime authority flags remain false.

host_runtime_probe for antigravity or agy returns lattice.host_runtime_probe.v1 with host antigravity and cliCommand agy, reporting ready or unavailable from the local agy binary without falling back to another current host.

edge.desc: Host normalization accepts antigravity, agy, and case variants consistently, while empty or unknown host errors list the current choices using antigravity or agy and no longer present Gemini as a normal current option.

If the agy binary is not on PATH, the probe remains safe and diagnostic-only: status unavailable, runtimeKind missing-cli, no subprocess launch, and nextAction explains how to expose agy or use fake for deterministic local coverage.

adversarial.desc: Adding Antigravity updates every registry seam together: HostRuntimeId, runtime order, CLI command map, runtime template, handoff target, policy host validation, and dispatch selection cannot disagree or route Antigravity work to Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, or fake by accident.
Antigravity probe/list/plan outputs never claim authorityChanged, receiptVerified, or productionDone; local runtime readiness stays diagnostic even when agy is installed.

items.title: Update dispatch policy and runtime surfaces for the current three-host set
items.context: Host runtime list/probe/status and policy allow-lists must recognize Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and Antigravity CLI. Error messages and docs should stop presenting Gemini as a current host.

items.title: Verify agy host detection and legacy Gemini behavior
items.context: Add focused smoke coverage or command verification proving host_runtime_probe accepts antigravity/agy and reports the agy command, while Gemini remains legacy rather than the advertised current host.
